_comment: Additive product metadata read by the hosted catalog. NOT required for standalone or native plugin install. Repo-as-one-plugin: the whole repo installs as the 'supercmo' plugin; all skills under skills/ ship with it. proof_points: process/framework claims only, no dollar figures.
target_audience: Indie hackers and SMBs running their own marketing
pain_points: Producing on-brand marketing media — images, video, voiceover — without a designer or agency
value_proposition: An AI marketing team that generates campaign-ready visuals and audio on your own API keys
proof_points: Provider-blind routing picks the right model per brief; bring-your-own-keys, runs in any SKILL.md agent
